feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 October 2026 4:10pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 01 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland will bring fronts overnight and through tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 occasionally 6 this evening, then 4 or 5 again later tonight. Then increasing South or Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, 6 or 7 by late morning or early afternoon, although a force lighter in Liverpool Bay.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough tomorrow afternoon. Locally slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers or rain tonight and tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 6 or 7, veering and decreasing West 4 or 5 later tomorrow evening or early in the night, then further decreasing 3 or 4 late in the night. Backing South 3 or 4 by Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight.


##Weather##

Rain clearing, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, improving good.
